title: Lightweight WS propagation shim & sampling heuristics for long-lived connections
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Implement a lightweight propagation shim and sampling heuristic tailored for long-lived connection protocols (WebSocket/SSE) used by Redwood SDKs and edge proxies. Goal: preserve trace continuity across upgrade/handoff events while reducing header overhead and improving sampling signal for low-QPS, long-lived clients (mobile apps, browser tabs, edge workers). Deliverables: (1) binary header packing format + thin shim for Node/Python SDKs and edge proxy, (2) sampling heuristics that bias towards root-span capture on connection start and periodic heartbeat sampling, (3) compatibility layer with OTEL/TraceContext and existing request-carrier middleware, (4) integration tests, perf benchmarks, and rollout plan with canary metric targets.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Ayesha Patel: Triage complete. Identified customer complaints about missing traces for long-lived connections (internal support ticket #24591). Initial scope prioritizes WebSocket and SSE paths in SDK and edge proxy.
2025-02-22 - Miguel Ortega: Prototype binary header packing for Traceparent + sampling flags (GZIP-lite) completed. Microbenchmarks show header reduction from ~512B to ~96B in median cases.

2025-02-27 - Design review: PM and Platform SRE provided feedback to bias sampling towards connection bootstraps and periodic heartbeats at 1/100 for low-throughput clients. Agreed to expose a per-client override via SDK config.
2025-03-01 - PR opened: runtime#4827 implements shim in edge-proxy and Node SDK. Adds opt-in sampling config and migration fallback to verbose TraceContext headers if binary unpack fails.

2025-03-04 - QA: Integration tests added for cross-language propagation (Node -> Python -> Go). Discovered edge-case where proxy upgrades during active connection lost last-span; added handshake step to flush pending spans on upgrade.

2025-03-06 - Miguel Ortega: Performance tests running on dedicated staging cluster (a100). Latency overhead measured +0.9% p99 for 256 concurrent WS clients with heartbeat sampling enabled. Next: plan canary rollout with traffic split and dashboard alerts.

Next steps: finalize SDK adapters for Python and Go, extend e2e test to include serverless edge workers, schedule canary for 2025-03-18, prepare release notes and observability dashboards for the rollout.
